title: Password reset policy
text: Support agents may initiate a password reset only after two approved identity checks. Reset links expire after 20 minutes and may be used once.

title: Production access
text: Production access requires a named account, phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication, manager approval, and a ticket linked to the access grant.

title: Incident severity
text: Severity 1 incidents cause a complete critical-service outage or confirmed material data exposure. The incident commander must be assigned within 10 minutes.

title: Incident communications
text: For Severity 1 incidents, publish an internal update every 30 minutes and a customer status update at least hourly until mitigation.

title: Backup retention
text: Daily encrypted backups are retained for 35 days. Monthly recovery points are retained for 12 months and tested quarterly.

title: Restore testing
text: A quarterly restore exercise must recover one application database and verify record counts, checksums, and application-level reads.

title: Laptop encryption
text: Company laptops must use full-disk encryption with recovery keys escrowed in the approved device-management service.

title: Lost device response
text: Report a lost company device to Security within one hour. Security may remotely lock or erase the device after confirming ownership.

title: Data classification
text: Customer contracts and support exports are Confidential. Credentials, private keys, and authentication secrets are Restricted.

title: Restricted data sharing
text: Restricted data must not be sent through email or public chat. Use the approved secrets manager or encrypted transfer service.

title: Vendor review
text: A vendor handling Confidential data requires security review, a data-processing agreement, and an identified service owner before onboarding.

title: Vendor offboarding
text: Vendor offboarding removes accounts within 24 hours, exports required records, and obtains written confirmation of data deletion.

title: Change windows
text: Routine production changes occur Tuesday through Thursday between 09:00 and 15:00 UTC. Emergency changes follow the incident process.

title: Change rollback
text: Every production change requires tested rollback steps, an owner, success checks, and a maximum decision time for rollback.

title: Support response targets
text: Priority 1 support requests receive an initial human response within 15 minutes. Priority 2 requests receive a response within four business hours.

title: Support escalation
text: Escalate a request when the response target is at risk, the customer reports data loss, or two troubleshooting attempts fail.

title: Expense approval
text: Expenses above 500 GBP require manager approval before purchase. Expenses above 5,000 GBP also require Finance approval.

title: Travel booking
text: Book standard rail and economy air travel through the approved portal. Exceptions require written director approval.

title: New employee access
text: People Operations supplies the start date and role. Managers request least-privilege access at least three business days before the start date.

title: Departure checklist
text: For departures, disable interactive accounts by the effective time, transfer owned documents, revoke tokens, and record completion in the offboarding ticket.

title: Customer data deletion
text: Verified customer deletion requests are completed within 30 days unless a documented legal hold applies. Completion must be auditable.

title: Log retention
text: Security audit logs are retained online for 90 days and archived for one year. Access to archived logs is recorded.

title: Service ownership
text: Every production service has one accountable owner, an on-call rotation, a runbook, an SLO, and a documented dependency map.

title: Post-incident review
text: A blameless post-incident review is required within five business days for Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents. Actions need owners and due dates.
